description: Setup wizard for an Umbraco package or project. Checks each piece the pipeline relies on (solution, CLAUDE.md, .gitignore, memory, plan folders, demo site ports, lint, tests, local CMS source and docs clones) and offers to add what's missing, one step at a time. Use for a new repo, a repo without CLAUDE.md, or to fill gaps later.
